label: D1 update gate tracks last reached state, strongly after rare transitions
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_common == 0) * table(prev_state, {1: 1, 2: -1}) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_common == 1) * table(prev_state, {1: 1, 2: -1}) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * table(prev_state, {1: 1, 2: -1})
explanation: Raw z of unit 0 sits near 1 at GO and D2 (residuals there of about 0.005), so all magnitude structure beyond timing is at D1, where the baseline is about 0.5 and falls late in the episode. At D1 it depends on the previous trial's reached state, and much more after rare transitions: after a rare transition into S1 (a2 S1) z is about +0.36 above baseline, after a rare transition into S2 (a1 S2) about -0.36; after common transitions the effect is about +/-0.13 (a1 S1 up, a2 S2 down). Reward adds a small extra push in the same direction as the state (+0.05). The ideal-observer belief log-odds has a small negative weight (it partly offsets the state effect once the state is accounted for). The trial before, choice repetition, and episode-time interactions add nothing (<0.003). Four observed-only terms reach dev R^2 beyond timing 0.734, against an all-observed ceiling of 0.75 and an all ceiling of 0.84; the earlier policy-based explanation used the model's choice logit (policy decile alone 0.40), but observed transition-and-state history covers almost all of that. Some residual remains in long streaks (repeated a1 S1 common trials push z higher than predicted).

issues: The reward claim only holds after controlling for belief. 'A previous reward adds a small push in the same direction as the state (+0.05)' is true only with belief_lo in the model. Without belief_lo, the reward-x-state term fits -0.040 on test (R^2 0.706). The raw residual table also shows reward pulling against the state direction: a1 S1 r +0.071 vs a1 S1 u +0.125, and a2 S2 r -0.082 vs a2 S2 u -0.116. The explanation should say the +0.05 is conditional on belief; on its own, a reward slightly weakens the state signal.

The other claims check out on test. GO/D2 residuals are below 0.007. The D1 timing baseline falls from about 0.49 to 0.34 late in the episode. Weights are +0.330 for rare-state and +0.114 for common-state, matching the residual table (rare about +/-0.4, common about +/-0.1). The four terms score test R^2 0.730 against an observed ceiling of 0.75. The trial before adds at most 0.003 (prev-prev state 0.7303, state x prev-prev state 0.7330, state-run 0.7300), and episode-decile interactions add at most 0.0004.

No large systematic error class remains. In misses, every phase x previous-trial bias is under 0.02 (largest: D1 after a1 S1 u +0.019 and D1 after a1 S2 r -0.020). Many of the worst windows are the first trial of the window, where the previous trial is unknown. A (phase==D1)*(prev_state<0)*belief_lo term fixes part of this (test 0.737).

The worst windows also show large spread within a cell: D1 z is about 0.8 after streaks of a1 S1c rewarded trials, where the model predicts 0.55, and is about 0.05-0.4 after a2 S2c trials. The terms do not capture this, but the observed ceiling (0.75) shows little additive headroom left.
